what_changed: FCC proposes requiring terminating providers to transmit verified caller name for A-attested calls (Rich Call Data), flagging foreign-originated calls and barring spoofing of US numbers from abroad; also asks which calling rules to simplify or eliminate.
rationale: Proposed duties fall on voice providers, not callers. Near the line because the request to streamline 'calling-related rules' could later reach TCPA rules that govern servicing calls, and verified caller name affects how servicing calls display.
